zh: 不仅仅是你，最近的研究表明，大自然可以调节我们的时间感。
en: It's not just you – recent research showed nature can regulate our sense of time.

zh: 这可以帮助我们确定行动的轻重缓急，从而实现我们的长期目标，而不是永远生活在“只求过得去”的状态中。
en: This can help us to prioritise our actions so that we meet our long-term goals rather than living in a perpetual state of "just about keeping our head above water".

zh: 这在一定程度上是因为在大自然中度过的时间似乎会让我们不那么冲动，使我们能够延迟即时满足感，转而追求长期回报。
en: This is in part because spending time in nature appears to make us less impulsive, enabling us to delay instant gratification in favour of long-term rewards.

zh: 为什么大自然会影响我们的时间观念？
en: Why does nature affect our sense of time?

zh: 其中一些好处或许可以解释为什么身处大自然中会改变我们对时间的体验。
en: Some of these benefits may explain why being in nature alters our experience of time.

zh: 亲近大自然
en: Accessing nature

zh: 在全球重要的羽毛球生产基地——贵州省锦屏县，每天超过10万只羽毛球从这里“飞”向全球。
en: In Jinping county of southwest China's Guizhou Province, a global production hub for badminton shuttlecocks, more than 100,000 shuttlecocks are sold worldwide a day.

en: In addition, treadmill exports jumped by 44.94 percent year-on-year in the first quarter, while artificial turf exports grew by 15.64 percent from the same period last year.

zh: 今年以来，这家公司已出口欧洲杯、美洲杯、奥运会等赛事用球及训练用球407万个。
en: Since the start of this year, the company has exported 4.07 million balls for training and games, including those used in the UEFA European Championship, Copa America, and the Paris Olympics.

zh: 周宏达认为，“中国制造”体育用品赢得海外市场的关键就在于不断创新，增加产品的科技含量，适应市场新需求。
en: Zhou believes that the key to the popularity of "Made-in-China" sporting goods overseas lies in continuous innovation, higher technological content, and adapting to new market demand.

zh: 中国企业不仅出口体育产品，同时也出口技术、服务和品牌。
en: Chinese enterprises are not just exporting sporting goods, but also technology, services, and brands.

zh: 给每门课程准备一个彩页笔记本和文件夹；
en: Color coded notebooks and/or folders for each class

en: Cleaning out your backpack, desk, and dorm room to reduce clutter from previous semesters

zh: 整理电脑文件，可以按照学年、学期、课程、作业或项目分门别类；
en: Organizing your computer files (e.g., by school year, semester, course, and assignment type or project)

zh: 如果你对截止日期了如指掌，知道每样东西放在哪儿，把空间整理得井井有条，你就可以把脑子腾出来专心学习，做出成绩。
en: If you keep track of deadlines, know where to find everything, and maintain a well-organized space, you free up your mind to focus on learning and achieving.

zh: 和条理性一样，做事有规律可以让你的生活更顺利。
en: Like being organized, establishing a routine helps your life run smoothly.

zh: 在近期（最近几周和数月内）一系列信号亮起后，美国经济陷入衰退的可能性正在上升。
en: The probability of a recession hitting the US economy is rising after a flurry of signals have flashed in recent weeks and months.

zh: 美国罗森伯格研究公司总裁大卫·罗森伯格在8月30日发布的一份报告中汇编了一份衰退指标清单。
en: That's according to economist David Rosenberg of Rosenberg Research, who compiled a list of recessionary indicators in a note on Friday.

zh: 罗森伯格表示，在历史上，一些令人担忧的信号只有在经济即将陷入衰退时才会出现。
en: According to Rosenberg, some worrying signals have historically only flashed on the precipice of an economic downturn.

zh: 罗森伯格编制的20个衰退指标中，有9个已经触发。
en: Of the 20 recession indicators compiled by Rosenberg, nine have been triggered.

zh: 被触发的衰退指标包括萨姆规则、先行指数和倒挂的收益率曲线等。
en: Some of the recession signals that have flashed include the Sahm Rule, the Leading Economic Indicator Index, and the inverted yield curve, among others.

zh: 而自那以后，关于美国经济衰退的警告越来越多。
en: But since then, the recession warnings have been growing.

zh: 根据新标准，高层建筑（10层以上）的商品住房中小套型住房建筑面积标准将从原来的100平方米上调到120平方米。
en: Under the new standards, flats in high-rise residential apartment buildings above 10 floors can have up to 120 sq m in gross floor area in comparison to 100 sq m before.

zh: 诸葛数据研究中心高级分析师关荣雪表示，上海住房标准的变化符合上海的市场需求。
en: Guan Rongxue, a senior analyst at the Zhuge Real Estate Data Research Center, said the changes in housing standards in Shanghai are in line with the city's market demand.

zh: 调查数据显示，美国人觉得美国的经济现状无助于缓解他们的债务状况。
en: The survey data shows that Americans feel the economy isn’t helping their debt situation.

zh: 相似比例（32%）的信用卡债务人表示，自2022年初以来，高利率使他们的信用卡债务负担更加沉重。
en: A similar share (32 percent) say high interest rates have made their credit card debt burdens worse since the beginning of 2022.

zh: 辛国斌称，经过十年的快速发展，中国已成为全球机器人产业增长的有力推动者。
en: After a decade of rapid development, China has become a strong promoter of the growth of the global robot industry, Xin added.

zh: 截至2024年7月，中国拥有机器人相关有效专利超19万项，占全球比重约2/3。
en: As of July 2024, China boasted more than 190,000 effective robot-related patents, accounting for about two-thirds of the global total.

en: In the first half of this year, Luckin started discussions with BJ Food, the franchiser of Starbucks in Malaysia, to form a joint venture for entry into the Malaysian market.

en: In the domestic market, Luckin has sought growth by expanding into tea-based beverages, rolling out new products like the light jasmine tea, a runaway hit that sold 11 million cups in its first week.

zh: 此举意在抢占对咖啡店而言具有巨大增长潜力的下午茶市场。
en: The move is aimed to attract tea-drinking consumers during afternoons that are seen to have significant growth potential for coffee shops.

zh: 那么，究竟是什么让一些人比其他人对蚊子更有吸引力呢？
en: So, what exactly makes some people more attractive to mosquitoes than others?

zh: 该研究的首席作者、多伦多大学士嘉堡校区的凯蒂·塔姆博士表示，这种无聊感和专注度密切相关。
en: Dr Katy Tam at the University of Toronto Scarborough, the lead author of the research, said boredom was closely linked to attention.

zh: 塔姆和同事在《实验心理学杂志：总论》中介绍，他们开展了7项实验，参与者超过1200人。
en: Writing in the Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, Tam and colleagues report how they carried out seven experiments involving a total of more than 1,200 participants.

zh: 但是，该团队接下来的实验却发现，事实并非如此。
en: However, the team’s subsequent experiments suggest this is not the case.

zh: 暑期旅游出行人数增多，带动相关的交通运输、仓储和邮政业生产指数增长快于全部服务业增速。
en: With an increase number of tourists traveling during summer break, sectors such as transportation, warehousing and postal production grew faster than that of the service industry as a whole.

en: Consequently, the travel consulting rental services grow relatively faster than usual, said Liu Aihua, an NBS spokeswoman, at a news conference in Beijing on Thursday.

en: You may wonder what exactly the professional athletes eat for breakfast to be able to perform impressive physical feats.

en: The upcoming 2024 Summit of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation is expected to bear fruitful results to further deepen Sino-African relations, according to observers in Africa.

en: Adhere called for enhanced cooperation in digital inclusion, green transition, technology transfer, health, agriculture and security to achieve mutual benefits.

en: Dairy product companies from home and abroad are eyeing bigger opportunities in extending their consumer group from babies to adults in China, Financial Times newspaper reported on Monday.

en: A Feihe product is also designed to meet the healthier consuming habits for middle-aged and elderly people, according to the media report.

zh: 虽然你很可能会在吃之前放滤网里用流水冲洗一下，但新研究表明，即使是用水彻底清洗也不足以完全去除所有的农药。
en: And while you probably rinse off your produce in a colander before eating it, new research suggests even a thorough wash with water isn't enough to properly get rid of all the pesticides.

zh: 央行称，近期央行在原租赁住房贷款支持计划的基础上，完善推出了保障性住房再贷款。
en: The central bank has beefed up financial support for government-subsidized housing by establishing a re-lending facility for such projects, according to the PBOC.

zh: 央行称，下阶段，我国要完善住房租赁金融支持体系，引导更多社会资金投入房地产行业。
en: In the next step, China will improve the financial support system for housing rentals and direct more social capital investment into the sector, the central bank said.

zh: 中国蛙泳选手覃海洋也功不可没，以57.98秒的分段成绩力压四获金牌的法国游泳新星莱昂·马尔尚。
en: Qin, who swam the breaststroke leg, was also important with a sizzling time of 57.98 to upstage France's four-gold hero Marchand.

en: Olympic gold medals are not made entirely of gold.

en: So how much money is an Olympic gold medal worth today?

zh: 世界卫生组织表示，铅是没有安全摄入量的，尤其对儿童来说。
en: There is no safe level of lead, especially for children, according to the World Health Organization.

en: However, for healthy adults, risk analysis found little to worry about choosing to indulge in 1 ounce of dark chocolate now and again.

zh: 国家统计局30日发布数据称，新产业、新业态、新商业模式即所谓的“三新”经济去年为中国经济增长做出了更多贡献。
en: The added value of new industries, new business formats and new business models, dubbed the "three new" economy, contributed more to China's economic growth last year, official data shows Tuesday.

zh: 国家统计局数据显示，经核算，2023年我国“三新”经济增加值为223528亿元，比上年增长6.4%。
en: Calculated at current prices, the added value of the new growth drivers was around 22.35 trillion yuan ($3.13 trillion) last year, growing by 6.4 percent from the previous year, according to the NBS.

zh: 2024年巴黎奥运会开幕周最有趣的时刻之一发生在游泳赛场上。
en: One of the most amusing moments during the opening week of competition at Paris 2024 occurred in the pool.

zh: 一名身穿花色泳裤的中年志愿者跳入水中，捡起丢失的泳帽，此举赢得了观众的掌声。
en: It saw a middle-aged volunteer dressed in colorful trunks dive into the water to receive a lost swimming cap before lapping up applause from the crowd.

zh: 这顶帽子被认为属于美国队游泳运动员艾玛·韦伯。
en: The cap was believed to have been the property of Team USA swimmer Emma Weber.

zh: 然而，当镜头转向这名运动员时，她仍然戴着帽子。
en: However, when the camera panned to the American, Weber was still wearing a cap.

zh: 为什么奥运会游泳运动员要戴不止一顶泳帽？
en: Why do Olympic swimmers wear more than one swimming cap?

zh: 你可能会认为答案显而易见：以防其中一顶泳帽掉下来。
en: You might think that the simple answer is: In case one of them falls off.

zh: 这个答案算正确，但不完全正确。
en: That is partly true but not quite the full story.

zh: 奥运会游泳运动员戴两顶泳帽，有时甚至更多，主要有两个原因。
en: There are two main reasons why Olympic swimmers wear two - or sometimes more - caps.

zh: 其一是戴多顶帽子可以帮助稳定运动员的护目镜。
en: One is that wearing multiple caps can help to stabilise an athlete's goggles.

zh: 除了增加额外的紧度外，第二顶泳帽还可以盖住护目镜周围暴露的带子，使运动员的服装更加贴合流线型，从而减少阻力。
en: As well as adding additional tightness, a second swimming cap can help cover up the exposed straps around the goggles, thus making the athlete more streamline and reducing drag.

zh: 大多数运动员会把护目镜套在乳胶泳帽上，然后再在上面戴一顶硅胶帽。
en: Most athletes will sit their goggles on a swimming cap made from latex, before adding a silicone cap on top.

zh: 理论上，硅胶和乳胶之间的摩擦应该会大大降低泳帽脱落的可能性。
en: The friction between the silicone and the latex should, in theory, make it much less likely for the top cap to fall off.

zh: 7月29日，随着美国联邦政府继续以创纪录的速度积累债务，美国国债历史上首次超过35万亿美元。
en: The U.S. national debt surpassed $35 trillion for the first time in the nation's history on Monday as the federal government continues to accumulate debt at a record-setting pace.

zh: 与此同时，美国债务预计今年将达到国内生产总值（GDP）的99%。
en: The U.S. topping $35 trillion in total debt comes as the debt held by the public is projected to reach 99% of the size of the U.S. gross domestic product this year.

zh: 独立机构国会预算办公室预测，2027年美国债务将刷新纪录，达到GDP的106%以上。
en: The nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office (CBO) has projected the debt held by the public will reach a record level of more than 106% of GDP in 2027.

zh: 根据国会预算办公室的最新估计，今年联邦政府将出现1.9万亿美元的预算赤字。
en: This year the federal government is projected to run a $1.9 trillion budget deficit, according to the latest estimate by the CBO.

zh: 这将比去年的赤字高出2000亿美元，而国会预算办公室对今年的最新预测比2月份公布的数据高出约4080亿美元。
en: That would be $200 billion larger than last year's deficit, while the CBO's latest estimate for the current year is about $408 billion larger than an estimate published in February.

en: The six-day event featured 15 exhibition halls with themes including architecture technology, manufacturing, green energy and modern agriculture.

en: Savor, a California-based startup backed by legendary businessman Bill Gates, has come up with a method of producing butter-like fat out of just carbon dioxide and hydrogen.
